visual_rules.composition: One continuous warm-paper sheet with a flat editorial ledger; hierarchy comes from rules, columns and spacing rather than nested cards
visual_rules.hierarchy: Large Chinese title, oversized outlined issue number, one metadata band and seven evenly spaced repository rows
visual_rules.accent: Avatar-derived gold is reserved for rank one, panel marker, stars and small navigation cues
visual_rules.texture: Subtle paper grain, warm-neutral hairlines and restrained gold accents; no nested rounded panels or large shadowed containers

typography_rules.primary: Noto Sans SC / Microsoft YaHei UI / system sans
typography_rules.readability: Check every text role after the whole card has been fitted into a normal browser window

overrides.browser_preview: Fit the complete fixed canvas inside the viewport, with scrolling as a fallback
